newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Naphtha/Mogas - Naphtha at nine-month low.
newsitem.headline: Asia Naphtha/Mogas - Naphtha at nine-month low.

text.p: Naphtha slipped to nine-month lows while gasoline's losses were marginal on buying support, traders said on Thursday.
Naphtha July swaps fell 60 cents per barrel to $20.40/$20.60, while physical barrels, assessed at a 40-60 cents premium, were quoted around the $21.00 mark.
Southeast Asian demand was limited to Thailand where a cargo of Egyptian grade naphtha was said sought for July delivery.
Gasoline was actively talked on the 92-octane and 97-octane unleaded grades with two European majors offering at $23.70 per barrel and $24.55 respectively.
A Japanese trader bought the 50,000 barrels of 97-octane liftng July 9-14.
On Wednesday, the same trader bought 50,000-barrels of 92-octane unleaded gasoline at $23.85 per barrel for July 3-7 lifting from a European trader.
Fundamentally, traders assessed the market as balanced although more supplies were begining to emerge.
A trader said a prompt June 23-27 lifting cargo was being tendered by Thai refiner Rayong Refinery Co Ltd.
The tender which is offering the 200,000 barrel cargo of 95-octane unleaded gasoline, closes on Friday.
But sources at the joint venture refinery between the Royal Dutch Shell Group and the Petroleum
Authority of Thailand (PTT) were unable to confirm the tender.
Some traders said the tender took them by surprise as the Rayong refinery had just returned from a 10 day shutdown of its 30,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) reformer.

State-owned Vietnam National Petroleum Import-Export Corp (Petrolimex) issued a tender seeking its third quarter requirements of 144,000 tonnes of 83-RON, 0.15 gram per litre leaded gasoline in eight cargoes of 18,000 tonnes c+f Ho Chi Minh City, Danang or Hongai, an industry source said.
The tender closes at 1600 hours (Hanoi time) on June 27 and offers will be valid until July 4.
In the second quarter, Vietnam purchased six 18,000-tonne cargoes, totalling 108,000 tonnes, at a premium of 80 cents per barrel to Singapore naphtha quotes c+f.
(Prices are in dollars per barrel)
